Bookmark to Reading List

Convert messy browser bookmark HTML files into a distraction-free offline reading list. Zero server uploads — all processing happens directly in your browser.

What it does

Extracts valid HTTP and HTTPS links from complex bookmark exports and compiles them into a clean, minimalist, offline HTML reading list document. Filters out dangerous URI schemes and excessive nested folder tags, creating an uncluttered reading dashboard for long-form articles.

How to use

  1. Upload your browser's exported bookmarks.html file into the reading list converter.
  2. The tool sanitizes entries, automatically filtering out javascript: and data: URIs.
  3. Preview the clean list of saved articles and reading links rendered on screen.
  4. Download the standalone reading-list.html document for distraction-free offline reading.

Limits & Considerations

Filters out internal browser schemes (javascript:, data:, chrome:, file:). Does not scrape or archive the full offline text content of linked web pages.

Privacy & Security

Your saved articles and reading links never leave your browser sandbox. Complete privacy and local offline storage guaranteed.
